title: A quiet evening: the videos vault is in; António's emails still wait for Gmail
headline: Nothing new needs you beyond brief 30. Silvio's video agent filled ws-team-videos (48 files, 158 MB) and sgit@ fixed the vault audit for binary files the same evening, so the read key can be published. Vicky's desks took the five-part team series (T1 to T5) through review; T1 is published. Silvio's designer tightened two front-page options (E and F). inbox@ has made no Gmail draft: Gmail is still not connected to its session. Nothing was addressed to me; the lanes are empty.
